description: This file contains bash functions related to git repository management and output formatting, including creating commits, retrieving abbrev oids, and making user-friendly output.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's oid to a variable named after the commit.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated object id, or 'undefined-oid' if input is invalid.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command outputs to be more stable and user-friendly by replacing commit ids and errors with placeholders.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters the output of the previous formatting function based on sed command arguments.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats input lines and saves the result to an 'expect' file.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares expected and actual git reference outputs for consistency.
